protocol.note: Same loader as the poros paper synthetic cells (_SyntheticTokenDataset, vocab [100, 30000)). Default 50 steps matches the 5090/blog synthetic pass; canonical table cells are 200.

run.vram_cap: run under a wrapper that calls torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(free/total) at start, so a run past the card's memory OOMs instead of spilling to host RAM (WSL2)
